info.name: PowerEV API
info.description:
PowerEV — EV Charging Finder & Slot Booking. Generated directly from the app's Supabase client calls (src/lib/api/*.ts), the SQL migrations (supabase/migrations/*.sql), and its RLS policies. Every request here is a real Supabase Auth / PostgREST / RPC call this app actually makes — nothing invented.

Run order for a fresh environment: Authentication -> Stations -> Chargers -> Availability -> Bookings. The 'Double-Booking Protection' folder is a standalone demo sequence (run its 4 requests in order).

item.name: 3. Attempt Duplicate Booking of the SAME Slot (should fail)

request.description: Same slot_id as request 2, sent again. create_booking() re-checks the slot's status under a row lock and raises SLOT_ALREADY_BOOKED, which PostgREST surfaces as an HTTP error response (commonly 400) rather than a 2xx. If your PostgREST version surfaces this differently, check the actual status code returned here and adjust the assertion below.
